Training with brief high-intensity intervals (85% of V ˙ O 2 peak) interspersed with recovery was shown to increase thigh muscle cross-sectional area by 24% in middle-aged people with type 2 diabetes, indicating a potential dose-response relationship between hypertrophy and aerobic intensity, at least in a metabolically compromised population.
